# Order concerning delivery of retained originals

⟦PERSON|Aoife McLarnen⟧, Plaintiff

v.

⟦ORG|Juniper Quoin Archives LLC⟧, Defendant

The plaintiff requests delivery of the original inspection notes after payment of the agreed copying charge. The defendant has supplied scans but accepts that several handwritten annotations are not legible in the scanned version. The earlier undertaking required delivery of the originals, not merely provision of an electronic image.

The defendant must make the originals available for collection within ten days. Before collection, it must provide an inventory identifying the number of pages and any missing attachment. A statement that the file is complete must be based on a comparison with the original deposit list.

The authorised collection contact is ⟦PERSON|Çağla O'Vennick⟧. Telephone: ⟦PHONE|+1 (202) 555-0164 x207⟧. The extension is required to reach the collection desk and is part of the contact value supplied for this order.

The plaintiff may nominate another collector by a signed instruction supplied before the appointment. A nomination does not authorise removal of other deposited material or acceptance of a charge not agreed in advance.

Costs are reserved. This order does not determine whether an unreadable annotation supports the plaintiff's underlying claim. Rule 12 and paragraph 7.2 of the existing directions remain applicable.

Entered on 30 December 2026. Authenticated by ⟦PERSON|Orlan MacRusk⟧.
